description: ClickHouse's spec marks no response member required, so PostgresService.id is optional, and a caller must handle a createPostgresService answer without the new service's ID. It is always present: Alchemy's ClickHouse Cloud provider created a Postgres service, waited on it, updated it and deleted it by the `id` the create returned (live, 2026-11-12), and ClickHouse's Terraform provider (ClickHouse/terraform-provider-clickhouse at 66ecf4fa, internal/api) stores that `id` as the resource ID and waits on it. Marking PostgresService.id required lets callers read the ID without checking for undefined.
